thread:
maria: heads-up — preflight failed for canary deploy 2026-03-20T09:40Z. deploy-bot flagged the artifact-verify step: checksum mismatch on wheel upload. blocking promote.

deploy-bot: [automated] preflight check failed for build 20260320-221. step=artifact-verify status=FAIL details="checksum mismatch: expected=sha256:abc123 got=sha256:def456" link=https://ci.internal/runs/20260320-221

alex: :eyes: which region? staging or canary-prod? any reruns?

maria: staging (us-west2 canary). I retriggered the pipeline twice, same error.

jamie: can we pin to previous image/digest and promote that while infra investigates? we need to decide before the change window closes.

sarah: prefer rollback to last promoted digest. but we need a short blurb in release notes and a changelog entry. who's owning the rollback/pin?

carlos: preliminary look — remote cache TTL and multipart reassembly ordering seem suspicious. occasional s3 multipart manifests can reorder parts which changes checksum if clients concatenate non-deterministically. infra is digging.

infra-bot: [automated] investigation ticket created: INF-1298. Attached: s3-upload-log.txt, multipart-manifest.json.

maria: I'll reupload artifacts with deterministic multipart ordering (using single-part upload or consistent part-checksum ordering). Trying `aws s3 cp --expected-size` trick, then re-run. ETA ~20m.

alex: if reupload succeeds, please manual-verify locally: `python -c "import hashlib; print(hashlib.sha256(open('package.whl','rb').read()).hexdigest())"` and compare to the manifest sha.

jamie: agree. fallback plan: if reupload doesn't fix it, pin pipeline to previous digest `sha256:zzz999` and promote that image. We need sign-off for exception to canary auto-promote policy. Post digest and I can prepare the promote command.

sarah: I can sign off for emergency promote to previous digest for stability. Post the exact digest and I'll approve.

maria: reupload complete. artifact now reports sha256:zzz999. kicking the preflight.

deploy-bot: [automated] preflight check started for build 20260320-221 (reupload)
deploy-bot: [automated] preflight check passed for build 20260320-221 step=artifact-verify status=OK

alex: nice. recommendation: hold canary for 30m observation window to watch error traces and latency, then promote if stable. Add a short release note: "hotfix: artifact reupload to fix checksum drift during multipart uploads"

jamie: I'll handle promote ordering and update CHANGELOG.md. Also adding a CI gate to re-run artifact digest check post-upload to avoid auto-promote on flaky uploads.

sarah: :shipit: once 30m observation window passes with no regressions. Please document root cause and mitigation in INF-1298, and add a permanent fix ticket for deterministic multipart uploads.

maria: adding note to release docs and closing loop here. thanks all :tada:
